cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

mechanism: A grants escalating time-off concessions from above, answering each sacrifice by taking on more work to regain the lead.
confusable: Ordinary gratitude repays proportionately; D43 needs each newly revealed favor to cause a bigger sacrifice.
comparison: Work shifts and canceled travel differ from the meal-care alternative physical gifts and freezer capacity.
seedUse: Use D43-b prior cover and airport-driving sacrifice, with S01 approving leave as the form of competitive generosity.
